senses.gloss: מִלֵּל, מִי׳ (b. h.; [to present, show; cmp. הִגִּיד, חִוָּה,] to proclaim, utter, speak.
units: <cite ref="Horayot 13b:13">Hor. 13ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 18a:9">Meg. 18ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Makkot 10a:17">Macc. 10ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 106:2">Ps. CVI, 2</cite>) <he>למי נאה למַלֵּל וכ׳</he> whom does it become to utter the mighty deeds &c.?—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 2:10:5">Y. Keth. II, 26ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>שמענו פלוני מְמַלֵּל על פלו׳ אשתו</he> we heard that man speaking of (pointing out) that woman as his wife; <he>מְמַלֶּלֶת על בניה</he> speaking of her children; a. e.—[<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27:2">Lev. R. s. 27</cite> <he>מי מלל</he>, read: <cite ref="M01458"><he>מָל</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="M00484"><he>מוּל</he></cite>, II, 2.—Lam. R. introd. (R. Hăn. 1) <he>מְמַלְּלִים</he>, v. <cite ref="L00577"><he>לִמְלֵם</he></cite>.]
